concept.title: Viewing X-Author Templates in Conga Drive v202407.2.0
concept.shortdesc: The Conga Drive system can store your documents as templates for use with Composer, Conga

conbody.p: The Conga Drive system can store your documents as templates for use with Composer, Conga Sign for Web, CPQ, X-Author, and CLL systems. Your templates must be created on your local machine. For more information on Conga Drive, see Conga Drive Configuration.
Conga Drive supports the following file types: PDF, .doc, .docx, .xls, .pptx, .ppt.
